blocks.en: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.
blocks.zh: 目的: 描述对乳腺损伤管理文献进行临床检索强化生成(RAG)系统的证据意识检索评价协议,解决检索分数依赖注释覆盖的问题。 方法: 采用了18个文件汇编和18个村发展基准,每个文件有一个是/否或WH问题。 检索集成密集嵌入,BM25,以及交叉编码器重排. 春克尺寸128至1024令牌,重叠0至20%,4个检索器配置得到评价. 相关性由与所有含有块的证据跨度所界定,将重叠块和同等证据视为相关。 检索使用R-精确度、Recall@K、MRR和nDCG@K进行了评价。 另外,采用DeepEval索赔水平的度量衡,以512吨指数(K=1至5)评估生成量,深层Seek-v4-pro为LLM法官,BLEU/ROUGE计量。 结果: 选定的混合检索器使用384个托肯块和20%的重叠,在18个查询中的17个查询中检索到前三个结果中接受的证据。 召回@3,R-精密度,MRR@3和nDCG@3各达到0.94. 地面真相调查把证据从25个增加到37个,接受的块指标从36个增加到51个,而不会改变检索的排名。 结论:Cross-encoder重排实现最高检索分数. 扩展的关联性说明增加了公认的证据而不改变排名,突出了注释的敏感性. 小型开发组和检索信息化的目录需要独立的验证,包括放射学家对证据充足程度的评估。

blocks.en: Management of benign and high-risk breast lesions requires integrating imaging findings, biopsy pathology, radiologic–pathologic concordance, and patient risk. Supporting evidence is distributed across society guidelines, appropriateness criteria, and lesion-specific studies, which may differ in their recommendations. For lesions of uncertain malignant potential (B3 lesions), international consensus supports vacuum-assisted excision as an alternative to open surgery for selected categories [ rageth2019b3 ] , whereas U.S. guidance permits imaging surveillance for selected radiologic–pathologic concordant lesions [ asbrs2024highrisk ] . Retrieving the correct recommendation therefore requires preserving the clinical conditions under which it applies.
blocks.zh: 对良性、高风险乳房损伤的管理需要整合成像结果、生物心理学、放射病理协调以及病人风险。 辅助证据分布于社会准则、适当标准和针对具体疾病的研究中,其建议可能有所不同。 对于不确定的恶性潜在损伤(B3损伤),国际共识支持将真空辅助切除术作为选定类别(ragth2019b3)开放手术的替代品,而美国指南则允许对选定的放射-病理协调损伤[abrs2024highrisk]进行成像监测。 因此,要收回正确的建议,就必须保留其适用的临床条件。

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) encode substantial clinical knowledge [ singhal2023medpalm ] but may generate unsupported statements [ ji2023hallucination ] . Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conditions answers on retrieved passages and makes supporting sources available for inspection [ lewis2020rag ] . In medical question answering, retrieval has improved performance in some settings, although outcomes depend on the corpus and retrieval strategy [ xiong2024medrag ] . Missing evidence can limit answer correctness, while supplying additional passages does not necessarily resolve the problem because language models may fail to use relevant information in long contexts [ liu2024lost ] .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)编码了大量临床知识[singhal2023medpalm],但可能生成不支持的声明[ji2023halllucination]. 检索到的生成(RAG)在检索到的通道上的条件答案,并提供辅助来源供检查[lewis2020rag]. 在医疗问题回答中,检索在某些环境下提高了性能,尽管结果取决于本体和检索策略[xiong2024medrag]. 缺失的证据可以限制答案的正确性,同时提供额外的段落并不一定解决问题,因为语言模型可能无法在较长的语境中使用相关信息[liu2024lost].

blocks.en: Medical RAG systems have been evaluated using guidelines and clinical resources, including clinical question answering and simulated oncology cases [ zakka2023almanac , ferber2025oncologyagent ] . Radiology-focused studies have also reported improvements that vary across models and sources [ tayebiarasteh2025radiorag , weinert2025radiographics ] . However, evaluation protocols remain heterogeneous [ amugongo2025ragreview ] , and expert assessment has identified retrieval and evidence selection as important failure points [ kim2025rethinkingrag ] . These findings motivate evaluating retrieved evidence separately from generated answers.
blocks.zh: 已利用准则和临床资源评估了医疗RAG系统,包括临床问题回答和模拟肿瘤病例[zakka2023almanac.,ferber2025oncologyagent]. 以放射学为重点的研究也报告了不同模型和来源的改进[tayebiarasteh2025radiorag,weinert2025放射学]. 然而,评价协议仍然是多种多样的[amugongo2025rag review],专家评估确定,检索和证据选择是重要的故障点[kim2025 rethinkingrag]. 这些调查结果促使人们评价所收集的证据和得到的答复。

blocks.en: Retrieval scores depend on which passages are annotated as relevant. When a benchmark recognizes only one chunk per question, another chunk containing the same supporting evidence may be scored as nonrelevant. Overlapping segmentation makes such alternatives more likely, while additional relevant passages may remain unannotated. In information retrieval, incomplete relevance judgments have long been recognized as a source of evaluation bias [ zobel1998reliable , buettcher2007biased , buckley2004incomplete ] . The effects on individual metrics depend on their definitions and the accepted evidence targets; overlap alone does not establish a fixed penalty.
blocks.zh: 检索分数取决于相关段落的注释。 当一个基准只承认每个问题的一个块时,另一个含有相同佐证的块可能会被评为不相关。 重叠分割使得这种替代方案更有可能,而其他相关段落可能仍未加说明。 在信息检索方面,不完全的相关判断长期以来被认为是评价偏向的一个根源[zobel1998可信赖、buettcher2007有偏见、bocky2004不完全]。 对个别衡量标准的影响取决于其定义和公认的证据目标;单靠重叠并不能确定固定的处罚。

blocks.en: Question-answering benchmarks have represented supporting evidence through answer spans, sentence-level facts, and source provenance [ rajpurkar2016squad , kwiatkowski2019naturalquestions , yang2018hotpotqa , petroni2021kilt ] . In RAG evaluation, conventional ranking metrics may not fully capture whether retrieved passages supply the information needed to answer a question [ yu2024ragsurvey ] . Chunk-based evaluation is also sensitive to how evidence is partitioned and repeated across overlapping segments [ smith2024chunking ] . Evidence-level relevance annotations can therefore reduce dependence on a single chunk identifier, provided that accepted alternatives are explicitly defined and audited.
blocks.zh: 问答基准通过回答跨度、句子层面的事实和来源提供了佐证证据[rajpurkar2016squad, kwiatkowski2019 Natural questions, yang2018hotpotqa, petroni2021kilt]。 在RAG评价中,常规的排名衡量标准可能无法完全掌握检索的段落是否提供了回答一个问题所需的信息[yu2024rag survey]. 以春克为基础的评价对证据如何在重叠的段间分割和重复也很敏感[smith2024chunking]. 因此,证据一级的关联性说明可以减少对单一块标识的依赖,但必须明确界定和审计可接受的替代品。

blocks.en: We present RAG-MAMA, a retrieval-augmented generation system evaluated on a curated 18-document breast-lesion corpus and an 18-query development benchmark. We investigate whether incomplete ground-truth annotations can underestimate retrieval performance. Canonical evidence spans are defined independently of chunk identifiers and mapped to each segmentation configuration. We distinguish alternative supporting chunks from complementary evidence requirements, audit previously unrecognized evidence while keeping retrieval rankings fixed, and separately evaluate retrieval configurations and generation quality. The system focuses on excision-versus-surveillance decisions, with fixed deferral for excluded categories. This study establishes a small-scale methodological baseline rather than demonstrating clinical effectiveness or validity on more complex, multi-evidence questions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出RAG-MAMA,这是根据18个文件的乳房液化体和18个水分发展基准来评估的回收-强化生成系统。 我们调查不完整的地面真实说明能否低估检索的性能. 条形证据跨度的界定独立于块状标识符,并映射到每个分区配置. 我们把替代支持块与补充证据要求区分开来,审计先前未确认的证据,同时固定检索等级,并分别评价检索配置和生成质量。 该制度侧重于割礼与监督决定,对被排除在外的类别进行定期推迟。 本研究确定了一个小规模的方法基线,而不是在更为复杂,多证据的问题上证明临床有效性或有效性.

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the RAG-MAMA pipeline. The corpus comprised 18 papers, which were preprocessed and split into 757 chunks (size 384, overlap 77). Each query was retrieved in parallel by a dense retriever (BGE-Large) and a lexical retriever (BM25). The two ranked lists were combined with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and reranked with a BGE cross-encoder. The top-K chunks were passed to Qwen 3.6 (27B) to generate a grounded answer. Retrieval was evaluated with ranking metrics and generation with DeepEval.
blocks.zh: 图1显示RAG-MAMA管道。 案卷由18份文件组成,经过预先处理,分成757块(384件,重叠77件)。 每个查询由一个密集的检索器(BGE-Large)和一个词典检索器(BM25)平行检索. 两个排名的榜单与对等Rank Fusion合并,并以BGE交叉编码器重新排名. 上K块被传递到Qwen 3.6(27B)生成一个有根据的答案. 检索被评价为排名度量衡,代代为DeepEval.

blocks.en: 2.1 Corpus Compilation, Pre-processing, and Quality Assurance
blocks.zh: 2.1 公司汇编、预处理和质量保证

blocks.en: The corpus was scoped a priori to a fixed reference table of 15 breast pathology categories defined by the American Society of Breast Surgeons (ASBrS) high-risk lesion taxonomy [ asbrs2024highrisk ] .
blocks.zh: 美国乳房外科医生协会(ASBrS)对15种乳房病理学分类进行了界定。

blocks.en: Thirty candidate documents were assembled by purposive expert selection, comprising society guidelines, American College of Radiology (ACR) appropriateness criteria, World Health Organization (WHO) classification, and lesion-specific primary literature. Documents were eligible if they provided management recommendations, upgrade-risk estimates, radiologic–pathologic concordance criteria, or nomenclature definitions for at least one retrieval-eligible category. Each was evaluated by category-specific term frequency and adjudicated by full-text review. Malignant categories and fibromatosis/desmoid tumor are not answered by retrieval: a scope gate applied to the normalized pathology label returns a fixed deferral before retrieval runs. Fibromatosis is excluded because current sarcoma guidance favors active surveillance over the excision and desmoid text remains in the indexed corpus.
blocks.zh: 30份候选文件通过有目的的专家甄选汇编而成,其中包括社会准则、美国放射医学院的适当性标准、世界卫生组织(卫生组织)的分类和针对疾病的初级文献。 文件如果提供管理建议、升级风险估计、放射病理协调标准或至少一个检索合格类别的术语定义,则有资格。 每一份都按特定类别的术语频率进行评价,并通过全文审查作出裁定。 恶性分类和纤维瘤/寄生瘤不通过检索进行解答:在正常病理标签上应用的瞄准门在检索运行前返回固定延时. 将纤维瘤排除在外,因为目前的沙科马指导倾向于对切割术进行积极监测,而脱毛文字仍留在索引中。
